title: tjvz subscriptions.yaml
description: The RSS/Atom feeds tjvz fetches. `tjvz sub add <url>` appends an entry (prompting for kind + persist). `kind` and `persist` have no default - a missing one is a load error, not a guess.

kind.description: how to read the feed. publication: pub <- channel title. author: pub <- item host, author fixed. reader: pub <- item host, each item also becomes a readers[] signal. topic: pub <- item host, requires apply_tags (the venue is incidental).

persist.description: how long an unjudged item stays in the feed. forever = until judged. <N> = N days from first_seen, then dropped silently (not a dismissal). 0 = never queued, ranked live from cache each fetch.

apply_tags.description: stamp these tags onto every item from this feed. Required in spirit for kind: topic.

max_items.description: intake cap - take at most the N newest new items per fetch, drop the rest. Optional; default: no cap.

paused.description: keep the entry, skip it on fetch

fetch_page.description: fetch the full article page instead of the feed's own text (opt-in; not v0)
